invariants_reviewed.name: registry_reference_lifetime
invariants_reviewed.reason: A reference becomes active only after successful list insertion. No cleanup path erases a pending claim before publication. Erase clears active/reference. Backing list splices preserve references; registry list insert/erase of other nodes preserve iterators.

invariants_reviewed.name: single_cleanup_responsibility
invariants_reviewed.reason: Rollback copies Backing and immediately removes its original backing node before releasing the domain lock; trivial destruction performs no implicit claim cleanup, so only the local copy can drop the claim.

invariants_reviewed.name: callback_reentrancy_and_registry_lock
invariants_reviewed.reason: Range registry lock is held only while inspecting/modifying registry nodes, never across provider or external callbacks. Detached backings are uniquely owned by their cleanup invocation while domain pending/maintenance blocks premature destruction.

invariants_reviewed.name: unknown_outcome_quarantine
invariants_reviewed.reason: Checked callback failures, thrown legacy/provider callbacks, unsafe overlap, and uncertain retain preserve the registry claim and poison/charge the domain without retry. Known retain failure consumes the claim without release.

invariants_reviewed.name: overlap_and_external_identity
invariants_reviewed.reason: External import still rejects overlapping ranges and reused external IDs. Owned publication scans all other non-releasing claims; only own-node identification changes from token equality to iterator equality. Token monotonic overflow guard remains.

invariants_reviewed.name: arena_cache_rejected_policies_absent
invariants_reviewed.reason: Normalized successful requests overwrite valid/bytes/alignment/iterator unconditionally exactly as HEAD. Same-shape requests use cached lower bound; different shapes scan from begin. No retained-shape or prefix-only cache candidate remains.

invariants_reviewed.name: public_abi
invariants_reviewed.reason: Changes are internal Backing representation/helper signatures; public headers and exported API definitions unchanged.
